thread:
Sam (oncall): paging — alert: 5xx rate spike from edge-proxy in us-west-2, started ~15:42 UTC. seeing lots of TLS client hello verify failures in proxy logs.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT CREATED • SEV: 2 • incident id: INC-2003334444 • paging oncall Sam • runbook: /runbooks/tls-failures
Sam (oncall): I'm on it. initial dashboard: 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% to 7.9% across prod-gateway-usw2. Latency also up.
Maya (eng-sre): logs show repeated "client_hello_verify: x509: certificate has expired" from edge-proxy-*. Also KMS rotator logs show recent cert push ~6h ago succeeded.
Karen (prod-support): several customers on support queue reporting 502/525 errors on inference calls, some timed out. Customer impact: degraded for ~12% of requests to certain dedicated clusters.
Sam (oncall): can someone dump a representative cert chain from the gateway and compare expiry?
InfraBot: rotator deployment 2003331200 completed 06:30 UTC — cert id: cert-prod-18, expiry: 2026-03-01T08:00:00Z (valid).
Maya (eng-sre): weird — edge-proxy logs show a different cert id: cert-edge-07, expiry: 2024-12-10T02:12:04Z -> EXPIRED. looks like an old chain being served by some frontends.
Javier (ops): I see stale certs on a subset of edge nodes (autoscaling groups ASG-edge-usw2-a/*). likely image w/ older trust store.
Sam (oncall): grep logs for node IDs returning expired cert.
Maya (eng-sre): pasted: 
```
edge-proxy-7f2a :: TLS ERROR client_hello: verify failed: x509: certificate has expired (notAfter=2024-12-10T02:12:04Z)
edge-proxy-4b9c :: presenting cert id=cert-edge-07
edge-proxy-1d3f :: presenting cert id=cert-prod-18
```
Sam (oncall): that confirms mixed certs. Looks like a partial rollout of new certs didn't complete, some nodes still have old bundle.
Karen (prod-support): what's short-term mitigation? customers are complaining.
Sam (oncall): immediate mitigation: 1) mark affected ASG instances out of rotation 2) force reload certs on remaining nodes 3) enable fallback route to eu-region or dedicated-backup route for impacted customers.
Mike (security): before we disable mTLS checks, note compliance implications — temporary allowance ok for SEV2 but document and notify.
Maya (eng-sre): scripting rolling-restart for ASG using `aws autoscaling start-instance-refresh --auto-scaling-group-name <asg> --strategy Rolling` would pick correct AMI, but takes ~6-8m per batch. I'll kick.
Sam (oncall): also pushing a host-level cert reload: `curl -X POST http://edge-proxy-4b9c:8080/admin/reload-certs` — will try on a small subset.
DeployBot: deploy 2003334400 (cert-rotation-fix) triggered to infra images — status: in-progress on 3/6 batches.
Javier (ops): I'm cordoning edge-proxy-7f2a from LB pool to stop traffic while we respawn with new image.
Maya (eng-sre): quick test: `openssl s_client -connect gateway.prod:443 -showcerts` returned chain with cert-edge-07 on edge-proxy-7f2a; after reload, 2/3 nodes now present cert-prod-18. 1 node still stale.
Sam (oncall): routing fallback — enabling proxy fallback rule to route traffic from troubled customers to dedicated-gateway-fallback for next 30m. Doing now.
InfraBot: LB config updated: traffic reroute to dedicated-gateway-fallback for tag:customer:high_impact=true.
Karen (prod-support): communicating to impacted customers: drafting message — will provide ETA ~30m for resolution and workaround to retry.
Mike (security): confirm audit log capture for any temporary mTLS relaxation — we need to attach to incident ticket.
Maya (eng-sre): after rolling refresh batch 4, all nodes show cert-prod-18. 5xx rate falling in dashboard: 7.9% -> 1.6%. still above baseline.
Sam (oncall): hold on, seeing intermittent 525s from EU region now — likely some downstream proxies cached old cert chains.
Javier (ops): invalidated CDN edge caches and forced cert propagation via rotator: `rotatorctl push --id cert-prod-18 --force` — propagate succeeded.
Sam (oncall): monitoring customer error counts and latency. Paging SRE for postmortem.
Maya (eng-sre): root cause hypothesis: rotator pushed new certs to control plane, but an older AMI image with stale certs was used for a subset of edge instances during a scale-up event; partial rollout left mixed certs in service.
Karen (prod-support): current customer impact: 18 open tickets, 4 P1 support pings. Most can be mitigated if they retry or are routed to fallback.
Sam (oncall): current action items: Maya — complete ASG refresh and verify no stale certs; Javier — confirm LB draining completed and fallback remains; Mike — ensure audit and compliance note; Karen — update customer comms; I'll monitor and prepare handoff in 30m.
Maya (eng-sre): ASG refresh completed. verification script output: all edge nodes present cert-prod-18, no expired certs detected.
Sam (oncall): 5xx rate down to 0.4% and falling. I will start Incident Timeline doc and tag for postmortem. handoff: Sam -> Maya in 30m.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE • status: mitigating • impacted_customers: ~12% of requests previously, now 1% residual • next update in 15m.
Karen (prod-support): sent initial customer note and individual follow-ups for the P1s.
Maya (eng-sre): started a short RCA draft: partial cert rollout + stale AMI -> mixed certs served -> client_hello verify failures -> 5xx spike. Will add mitigation/timeline.
Sam (oncall): thanks all. If any re-occurrence, escalate to SEV1. I'll handoff active watch to Maya at 2033335044.
Maya (eng-sre): taking over monitoring. adding runbook improvements: rotator post-check to verify instance-level cert IDs and automated ASG image health check on any push.
Mike (security): logging compliance entry and approving temporary exception note.
Sam (oncall): handoff done. :white_check_mark:
